# Endangered Languages Project

> A global initiative documenting, preserving, and revitalizing endangered languages through community engagement, interactive resources, and collaborative language revitalization programs.

The Endangered Languages Project (ELP) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting indigenous language communities worldwide. The site provides interactive maps for language discovery, multimedia documentation resources, and connects users with revitalization programs and volunteer opportunities across Asia, Africa, the Americas, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Endangered Languages
- Language Revitalization
- Indigenous Languages
- Language Documentation
- Language Preservation
- Cultural Preservation
- Community Stories
- Language Resources
- Interactive Map
- Language Education
- Global Language Initiatives
- Volunteer Opportunities
- Language Community Support

## Core Resources

- [Home](https://endangeredlanguages.com): Homepage for Endangered Languages Project with language revitalization resources and community stories
- [Language Search (Map)](https://endangeredlanguages.com/language-search-map): Interactive map for searching endangered languages by location and filters
- [Language Resources](https://endangeredlanguages.com/language-resources): Multimedia library of language documentation and learning materials
- [Revitalization Programs](https://endangeredlanguages.com/revitalization-programs): Interactive directory of global language revitalization programs and initiatives
- [About Us](https://endangeredlanguages.com/about-us): Mission, vision, and values of the Endangered Languages Project nonprofit

## Community & Stories

- [Stories](https://endangeredlanguages.com/stories): Community stories about language revitalization and cultural identity
- [Events](https://endangeredlanguages.com/events): Calendar of language documentation and revitalization community events

## Get Involved

- [Get Involved](https://endangeredlanguages.com/get-involved): Ways to volunteer, contribute, and participate in language revitalization efforts
- [Volunteer](https://endangeredlanguages.com/volunteer): Volunteer opportunities including ambassador program and translation work
- [Contribute](https://endangeredlanguages.com/contribute): Ways to contribute resources, documentation, and event information to ELP
- [Donate](https://endangeredlanguages.com/donate): Donation page for Endangered Languages Project fundraising and support
